article.title: Exam Prep Books: 19 Titles from 3000 Studios Press (2026 Guide)
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every exam prep title from 3000 Studios Press in one place: 19 original books by Jeremy Swain, $9.99 each as EPUB and PDF.
article.leadParagraph: Looking for exam prep books? 3000 Studios Press publishes 19 original exam prep titles written by Jeremy Swain. Certification and licensing exam guides. This guide lists every one, explains what each shelf offers, and shows exactly where to buy them.

sections.heading: The full Exam Prep shelf
body: The shelf includes “Certified Welding Inspector Exam Prep (AWS CWI)”, “Sterile Processing Technician Exam Prep (HSPA CRCST)”, “Certified Surgical Technologist Exam Prep (NBSTSA CST)”, “NATE HVAC Certification Exam Prep”, “Journeyman Plumber Exam Prep — IPC & UPC” and “Journeyman Electrician Exam Prep — Calculations & Code Review”.

It also includes “Cosmetology State Board Exam Prep”, “Massage Therapy MBLEx Exam Prep”, “Certified Dietary Manager Exam Prep (CBDM CDM, CFPP)”, “Certified Energy Manager Exam Prep (AEE CEM)”, “PHR Exam Prep (HRCI Professional in Human Resources)” and “Certified Fire Protection Specialist Exam Prep (NFPA CFPS)”.

It also includes “LEED v5 Green Associate Exam Prep (GBCI)”, “Praxis Core Exam Prep (ETS Praxis)”, “Aircraft Dispatcher Exam Prep (FAA ADX)”, “Healthcare Quality Exam Prep (NAHQ CPHQ)”, “Certified Ophthalmic Assistant Exam Prep (IJCAHPO COA)” and “Dental Hygiene Exam Prep (NBDHE)”.
It also includes “The Fastest Guide to Getting Your Real Estate License — All 50 States”.

sections.heading: Price and formats
body: Every title on the shelf is $9.99. Each purchase includes both EPUB and PDF, delivered at checkout from the studio store on Payhip, so the same book works on an e-reader, a tablet, a phone or a printer.
Print editions of the wider 3000 Studios Press catalog are distributed through IngramSpark, which means bookstores and libraries can order copies through their usual channels.

sections.heading: Where to buy
body: Open the Books page at https://3000studios.vip/books and tap any cover to go straight to that title's checkout. The Exam Prep filter on that page shows only this shelf.
New releases and chapter previews land first in the free 3000 Studios Substack newsletter.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: How many exam prep books does 3000 Studios Press publish? 19, all listed above.
Who writes them? Every title is written by Jeremy Swain and published under the 3000 Studios Press imprint.
What do I get? A $9.99 purchase includes the EPUB and the PDF of the book.
